verdict.rationale: Lambda docs confirm each On-Demand instance ships with a preinstalled JupyterLab accessible directly from the Instances page, and instances can be reached via SSH (the standard mechanism VS Code/Cursor Remote-SSH uses) — both are one-step, no manual setup required (lambda-labs-docs-3, lambda-labs-docs-7, lambda-labs-docs-43). However, there is no explicit documentation of a native VS Code/Cursor 'Connect' integration or dedicated extension, so IDE connectivity relies on generic SSH rather than a purpose-built one-click flow. Missing for 10: explicit VS Code/Cursor remote-connect documentation or extension, and independent hands-on confirmation of a truly one-step IDE connection experience.
